A anatomical LEFT hand still holds exactly one small darkbronze 3curve boss token; B anatomical RIGHT hand still holds exactly one small tied silver cloth knot. Keep their held props near their prior central height and approximately one palm apart by A extending left forearm a little while body retreats, NOT joining hands or touching objects. B left arm empty relaxed by her own torso. No duplicate token at A waist, no knife drawn, B same small plain brown leather knife sheath right waist. No rope/sandbag/extra people. Minor old hand traces stay, no new wounds, no B left-ankle injury.
Door two original leaves slide slightly inward from former12cm slit to a narrower slit about6cm, still showing empty interior blue floor. NO full closure and no full opening, hands entirely outside safe of edges. Sole fine OUTERMOST circle track contracts to right semicircle warm amber; remaining left semicircle and all inner circles/spokes/glyphs stay dark. Do not draw luminous straight spokes, border lights or wide golden bands. The small pale pebble remains inside behind threshold, visible only if gap allows, never reappear outside. Frame head to feet, clear unpainted original ground crack reference and fore-aft stagger, door/panel dimensions consistent. Human anatomy, five fingers, natural cloth weight. No text/subtitle/watermark/logo. Static test pose only, not a proof of a continuous retreat or measured centimetres.
